title: Haven finance integration and platform audit acceptance
rules: No requirement is completed by authoring this roadmap.
PASS requires executed evidence for the declared layer; mocks do not satisfy provider/live gates.
NOT_APPLICABLE only for an unused product adapter with verified inventory and named scope approval; privacy, integrity, authorization and audit completeness cannot be waived.
Engineering, provider and live proof are distinct; full completion requires all applicable gates.
Copy this register into docs/finance-integration/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.json at implementation start and maintain IDs/evidence there.

requirements.title: Baseline and target identity
requirements.acceptance: Verify repository/worktree/dirty paths, deployment and database identity; preserve unrelated bytes.
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval
requirements.reviewer: root verification plus f00_independent_review scoped review

requirements.title: Complete entity and product inventory
requirements.acceptance: Every active entity has verified accounting company, product/edition, facilities and connection scope or an explicit blocked decision.
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval

requirements.title: Approved ownership and accounting policy
requirements.acceptance: Controller approves origin/owner, chart/control accounts, basis, fiscal dates, currencies, corrections and opening-balance treatment.
requirements.verification: Decision record and synthetic accounting examples
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval

requirements.title: Approved outbound privacy policy
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer approves allowlisted schema and aggregation context; identifiers or small aggregates are not presumed de-identified.
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval
blocked_by: D04: named privacy and payload approval

requirements.title: Complete audit action inventory
requirements.acceptance: Every active domain/route/API/RPC/job/file/offline path has applicable audit actions and planned evidence sink.
requirements.verification: Automated inventory and reviewed coverage register
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval
evidence: AUDIT-COVERAGE.json (provisional lexical candidates, not complete enforcement proof)

requirements.title: Quantified operating targets
requirements.acceptance: Document provider cadence, stale thresholds, expected volumes, existing performance budgets, RPO/RTO, retention and alert owners.
requirements.verification: Decision record with measurable acceptance targets
requirements.owner: implementation lead / controller for business approval

requirements.title: Atomic payment and allocation
requirements.acceptance: A failed allocation rolls back payment and event; concurrent identical requests create one receipt/allocation effect.
requirements.verification: SQL and authenticated API failure injection
requirements.evidence_scope: Reviewed SQL plus genuine native GoTrue/PostgREST and actual standalone Deno; no hosted, provider,342 dynamic-security or business acceptance

requirements.title: Content-bound idempotency
requirements.acceptance: Same identity and payload returns prior receipt; same identity with changed content returns conflict without effects.
requirements.verification: Unit, SQL and API concurrent tests

requirements.title: Atomic journal posting
requirements.acceptance: Header/lines/post/source receipt succeed together; abandoned draft is recoverable and never falsely classified as posted. F03 extends this boundary with outbound intent.

requirements.title: Posted journal and period enforcement
requirements.acceptance: All UI/direct API/import/job paths reject illegal posted edits and closed-period writes; simultaneous close/post serializes correctly.
requirements.verification: SQL concurrency plus authenticated route tests

requirements.title: Finance entity and current actor boundaries
requirements.acceptance: Wrong entity/accounts/facilities, stale/revoked session and mismatched execution authority are rejected at command boundary.

requirements.title: Audit export authorization repair
requirements.acceptance: Facility-A-only actor cannot create/process/read B or all-org exports; null-scope manipulation and revocation do not bypass limits.
requirements.evidence_scope: Reviewed SQL plus genuine native GoTrue/PostgREST and actual standalone Deno; no hosted, provider,342 dynamic-security or business acceptance

requirements.title: Approval invalidation and separation
requirements.acceptance: Amount/scope/account/mapping/member changes invalidate approval; preparer cannot satisfy required independent approval.

requirements.title: One authoritative resident-money ledger
requirements.acceptance: Cash, Finance, Forecast, statements and refunds use the same canonical records; duplicate legacy data has an evidenced resolution.

requirements.title: Trust transaction correctness
requirements.acceptance: Deposit/withdrawal/refund/transfer/close preserves balances/history; concurrent withdrawals cannot overdraw; money is not automatically offset to AR.

requirements.title: Trust three-way reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Resident balances equal liability control and dedicated bank funds after individually documented timing items.
requirements.verification: Independent fixture totals and actual pilot reconciliation

requirements.title: Typed historic opening balances
requirements.acceptance: Importing 10000 dollars historical AR leaves current revenue unchanged and retains original aging/payer/entity.

requirements.title: Repeatable historical import
requirements.acceptance: Same/overlapping source does not duplicate money; correction creates a reviewed revision; source hashes/control totals/crosswalk persist.

requirements.title: Accepted cutover controls
requirements.acceptance: Controller accepts opening TB/AR/AP/trust/cash/payroll and cutover watermark; pre-cutover records cannot re-export as new activity.
requirements.verification: Signed source controls and read-only comparison

requirements.title: Atomic durable outbound intent
requirements.acceptance: Every approved source event has one immutable intent and authoritative receipt, or the financial change rolls back.

requirements.title: Immutable aggregate membership
requirements.acceptance: An event/version belongs to at most one active accounting representation; member counts and amounts reproduce the payload exactly.

requirements.title: Unknown external outcome
requirements.acceptance: Timeout after provider commit blocks blind retry; read-back/reconciliation finds prior effect or routes unresolved exception.

requirements.title: Worker concurrency and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Leases, stale workers, retries and crashes preserve intent and produce one economic effect under tested paths.

requirements.title: Inbox correctness
requirements.acceptance: Invalid signatures rejected; duplicate/reordered/stale events deduplicated before effects; cursor advances only after durable processing.
requirements.reviewer: root: bounded signature/schema source APPROVE only

requirements.title: Connection and credential lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Wrong-company reconnect, revoke, rotation failure and concurrent refresh preserve safe stopped/queued state without leaking credentials.
requirements.reviewer: f00_independent_review: lifecycle-only APPROVE; independent dynamic security review incomplete

requirements.title: Outbound stop controls
requirements.acceptance: Global/per-connection stop prevents new external effects and preserves commands/receipts/inbound visibility.

requirements.title: Privacy allowlist enforcement
requirements.acceptance: Planted PHI in nested fields/memos/identifiers/filenames/errors/AI output cannot enter outbound payloads or operational logs; unknown fields rejected.

requirements.title: QBO adapter capability proof
requirements.acceptance: If selected, supported sandbox reads/auth/versioning/change notifications/catch-up and approved posting objects have executed proof.
requirements.verification: Current official docs and sandbox contract results
requirements.evidence_limits: Bounded synthetic read-capture proof only; provider capability, complete import and financial serialization acceptance remain open.

requirements.title: Desktop adapter capability proof
requirements.acceptance: If selected, managed Windows bridge binds correct company, schedules exchange and survives host/connector failure without duplicate effects.
requirements.verification: Edition-specific test company and host outage evidence

requirements.title: Quicken exchange capability proof
requirements.acceptance: If selected, edition-specific files validate/import with controls; supported manual posting requires acceptance evidence and readback. Product inability to represent the approved accounting model blocks compatibility acceptance and requires an owner/controller system or bridge decision; file exchange alone is not GL proof.
requirements.verification: Actual sanitized format samples and reviewed import/export proof

requirements.title: Full snapshot and catch-up completeness
requirements.acceptance: Source/normalized counts and totals match beyond every source cap; initial snapshot plus overlapping catch-up has no gaps.

requirements.title: Import quarantine
requirements.acceptance: Malformed, duplicate, changed, mismapped and partial files/pages remain quarantined or explicitly resolved; no false success.

requirements.title: Capability-aware UI
requirements.acceptance: Missing feature, data source or acceptance receipt is shown as unsupported/missing/pending, never zero/paid/current.

requirements.title: Validated summary booking model
requirements.acceptance: Selected provider or supported file/manual posting workflow proves approved account types/control/clearing/basis model without resident identifiers or dummy resident customers.
requirements.verification: Accountant-approved examples and selected-adapter controlled posting plus independent readback

requirements.title: No detail and summary duplication
requirements.acceptance: Mirrored export creates no new outbound event; detail and summary of same economic activity cannot both count or post.

requirements.title: Exact monetary representation
requirements.acceptance: Integer calculations and provider serialization preserve cents, currency and aggregate bounds beyond 32-bit values.
requirements.evidence_limits: Bounded synthetic read-capture proof only; provider capability, complete import and financial serialization acceptance remain open.

requirements.title: Correction lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Reversal/adjustment links original event/batch; prior versions remain reproducible; external edits/deletes/voids create review items.

requirements.title: Source to provider tie-out
requirements.acceptance: Released batch member counts, amounts and hashes match accepted provider record and imported mirror.
requirements.verification: Selected-adapter controlled posting receipt or manual acceptance record, plus independent source/provider reconciliation

requirements.title: Contractual charge generation
requirements.acceptance: Rates/concessions/proration/bed hold/admission/discharge/transfer effective dates produce approved expected charges and stop obsolete charges.
requirements.verification: Independent billing oracle fixture and browser tests
requirements.reviewer: f00_independent_review: temporal selection scope APPROVE only

requirements.title: Payer responsibility and authorization
requirements.acceptance: Resident plus payer shares equal charges; expired/retroactive authorization raises reviewed exceptions; contract rules are evidence-backed.
requirements.reviewer: f00_independent_review: temporal selection scope APPROVE only

requirements.title: Multi-invoice receipt allocations
requirements.acceptance: 1000 dollar receipt allocated 600 and 300 leaves 100 unapplied; duplicate request changes nothing; unapplied refund does not reopen paid invoices.

requirements.title: Remittance and denial lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: One remittance spans residents/periods with correct allocations; partial adjudication/denial remains outstanding or explicitly adjusted.
requirements.verification: Remittance fixtures and independent expected totals

requirements.title: Refund and settlement semantics
requirements.acceptance: 1000 receipt with 200 refund reports 800 net receipts; 1000 gross less 30 fee ties to 970 bank settlement without new revenue.

requirements.title: Resident lifecycle and fund disposition
requirements.acceptance: Transferred/discharged/deceased resident history remains attributed; refunds and remaining trust balances stay visible until evidenced disposition.

requirements.title: Purchasing/AP control chain
requirements.acceptance: PO/service approval, receipt, duplicate bill check, credits and payment evidence link correctly; marking paid cannot fabricate settlement.
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Vendor banking change authority
requirements.acceptance: Sensitive vendor changes require verified scoped approval and audit; no hidden payment initiation via connector.
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Payroll acknowledgment and actuals
requirements.acceptance: Downloaded file is not accepted payroll; provider results reconcile gross/deductions/employer cost/net and rejected lines remain open.
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Historical payroll and duplicate prevention
requirements.acceptance: Rate changes do not alter closed periods; revised time invalidates approval; off-cycle results/mileage cannot book through two origins.
requirements.verification: Payroll history, corrections and idempotency tests
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Overhead and capital classifications
requirements.acceptance: Official insurance/prepaid/debt/asset/depreciation/shared costs import with source/account attribution; estimates remain separate.
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Intercompany and consolidation
requirements.acceptance: Paired entries preserve both entities' authority; one-sided failure is an exception; eliminations change group reports only.
requirements.owner: AP and payroll engineering / provider operator

requirements.title: Opening movement closing reports
requirements.acceptance: Every balance report satisfies opening plus movement equals closing and separates recognized revenue, billed charges, receipts and cash.

requirements.title: No silent financial truncation
requirements.acceptance: Beyond 2000 rows and configured REST/source caps, exact counts/totals remain correct; failed pages block complete/reconciled status.
requirements.reviewer: f00_independent_review: bounded source guard/reporting APPROVE only

requirements.title: Stable reproducible snapshots
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent source changes cannot duplicate/omit rows in a snapshot; later corrections do not rewrite saved reports.

requirements.title: Source status truthfulness
requirements.acceptance: Missing is distinct from zero; source updated/complete/reconciled dates are separate; stale entity prevents all-current portfolio status.
requirements.reviewer: f00_independent_review: bounded source guard/reporting APPROVE only

requirements.title: Reconciliation exception workflow
requirements.acceptance: Unmatched count/amount, owner, evidence, age, disposition and approved timing items are visible; no unexplained cents tolerance.

requirements.title: All-domain audit coverage
requirements.acceptance: Every required domain/action/entry-point row links executed evidence; CI rejects undeclared new sensitive tables/routes/jobs.
requirements.verification: Coverage scanner plus positive/negative behavior tests

requirements.title: Enforced sensitive read audit
requirements.acceptance: Direct browser/PostgREST/RPC/server/storage/read/search/download paths are audited at enforceable boundaries or blocked for that action.

requirements.title: Actor and historical provenance
requirements.acceptance: Human/automation identities, scope at occurrence, before/after/version, reason, approvals and correlation survive transfer/offline/replay.

requirements.title: Complete authorized evidence export
requirements.acceptance: Stable export exceeds cap, includes changes and permitted evidence refs, exact counts, manifest/hashes; CSV safe; retrieval rechecks access.
requirements.verification: Export volume, concurrency, formula and revocation tests

requirements.title: Audit integrity and secret exclusion
requirements.acceptance: Application/integration roles cannot rewrite protected receipts; missing/changed anchored evidence detected; credentials absent from history.
requirements.verification: Privileged-role negative tests and integrity verification

requirements.title: Retention legal hold and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Approved retention categories, holds, attachment hashes and keys survive restore; no generic deletion or unsupported retention promises.

requirements.title: Clinical continuity during audit outage
requirements.acceptance: Audit transport failure does not erase/block necessary clinical capture without a durable pending path; finance posting receipt remains atomic.

requirements.title: Operational Finance navigation
requirements.acceptance: Role-aware work queues/reconciliation/close coexist with accountant controls; routes/context/keyboard/empty/error/reduced-motion behavior preserved.
requirements.verification: Authenticated browser and WCAG AA checks

requirements.title: Evidence-based close and reopen
requirements.acceptance: Close blocks incomplete/unresolved sources per policy; independent signoff and official snapshot recorded; reopen preserves original close version.
requirements.verification: SQL close/post race and browser close packet tests

requirements.title: Least-privilege drill-down
requirements.acceptance: Scoped financial auditor cannot open clinical charts or other entity evidence without explicit access.

requirements.title: Constrained useful AI
requirements.acceptance: Source-cited fresh explanations and draft matches work through approved runtime; prompt injection/self-approval/unauthorized tools denied; deterministic workflows work without AI.

requirements.title: Offline owner and approval safety
requirements.acceptance: Account switch/revocation cannot view or release another actor's queue; replay retains original observation and trusted receipt times.

requirements.title: Required tests actually execute
requirements.acceptance: Typecheck/lint/unit/build/SQL/Edge/authenticated UI/finance/audit/contract/privacy checks run with exit zero and relevant skips absent.
requirements.verification: Exact commands, JSON results and CI step evidence

requirements.title: Targeted independent reviews
requirements.acceptance: Independent code/security/accounting-workflow reviewers approve exact release commit and manifest after fixes; author does not self-approve.

requirements.title: Measured performance and operations
requirements.acceptance: Expected/high volume meets recorded budgets; source lag/failed jobs/unknown outcomes/audit gaps alert a named responder and recover per runbook.

requirements.title: Restore before source creation and external posting
requirements.acceptance: Restore before source/batch creation and separately before provider posting, with workers paused; recover source versions, membership, approvals, payload, mappings and command identity despite lost DB metadata, reconcile provider receipts, and resume without duplicated effects or invented provenance.

requirements.title: Verified release and rollback package
requirements.acceptance: Forward migrations/runtime/workers/flags/identities/backups are compatible; rollback stops writers and accounts for committed external effects.

requirements.title: Explicit live activation authority
requirements.acceptance: Identified target/company/entity/payload/mapping/transaction scope has required business/privacy and user activation approvals.
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Hosted layer and read-only shadow proof
requirements.acceptance: Deployed schema/edge/workers/Auth/PostgREST/browser operate correctly; read-only source comparison and opening controls reconcile.
requirements.verification: Exact deployed IDs and hosted authenticated evidence
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Scoped first production batch
requirements.acceptance: Approved batch posts once, is independently read back and reconciles to Haven source membership and official books.
requirements.verification: Production provider receipt and controller tie-out
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Sustained real operating cycles
requirements.acceptance: At least seven clean monitored operating days plus a real billing/collections cycle, payroll cycle and monthly close accepted; simulation is not live proof.
requirements.verification: Dated operations record and named business signoff
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Every active entity accepted
requirements.acceptance: Each mapped active entity has working required adapter/cadence, opening reconciliation, scoped staff UAT and first-close approval.
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Training ownership and final evidence
requirements.acceptance: Operators have tested runbooks/escalation/backup ownership; all required IDs have appropriate evidence and final independent approval.
requirements.verification: Training/recovery records and final acceptance report
requirements.owner: named controller and facility acceptors pending

requirements.title: Verified pre-dispatch evidence recoverability
requirements.acceptance: External dispatch waits for verified independently durable recovery package or tested WAL/PITR equivalent inside approved Haven boundary, including recoverable metadata/keys and source/member/approval/payload evidence. Missing acknowledgment blocks posting; storage success does not replace current approval.
requirements.verification: Recovery store failure, lost acknowledgment, metadata loss and key recovery tests plus independent restore proof
